title: Pocketwire Advance Late Fee Assessment
content:
Late fees on a Pocketwire Advance line are assessed one late-fee period at a time, on an advance that is past its grace period with principal still unpaid, and each late fee is booked by the agent on that advance under the number of the late-fee period it belongs to. A booked late fee raises what the customer owes on the line by that fee.

## Assessment at a glance

| Point | Late fee assessment |
|---|---|
| What is charged | One late fee for one late-fee period |
| Where it is booked | On the advance it belongs to |
| Numbering | By late-fee period, 1 for the first full late-fee period after the grace period |
| Who books it | The agent |
| Effect | What the customer owes on the line goes up by the fee |

## Booking a late fee: `assess_late_fee_a649c20a`

**Capability.** The tool books one late fee on an advance of a Pocketwire Advance line for the late-fee period given, with today's date and the amount given; the amount the customer owes on the line goes up by that fee. The customer sees the late fee, its period number and the higher amount owed in the advance activity straight away. The tool does not check eligibility, timing or earlier entries, and does not compute the amount it is handed.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `assess_late_fee_a649c20a`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `advance_line_id` | The reference number of the customer's advance line, as returned by the advance line lookup (`find_advance_lines`) | Identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | The reference number of the advance the late fee belongs to — its disbursement entry — as returned by the advance activity lookup for that line (`find_advance_ledger`) | Identifier |
| `fee_period` | The number of the late-fee period being charged | An integer, 1 or more (1 for the first full late-fee period after the grace period) |
| `amount` | The late fee in USD | 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed; stored exactly as given |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the booking: `fee_entry_id` (reference number of the new late fee entry), `advance_line_id` (the line), `advance_entry_id` (the advance charged), `fee_type` (always `late_fee`), `fee_period` (integer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `outstanding_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, what the customer owes on the line afterwards). A returned `fee_entry_id` means the fee is booked.
